newsitem.title: UK: European raw cotton markets are subdued.
newsitem.headline: European raw cotton markets are subdued.

text.p: Turnover in European raw cotton markets was subdued with mill buyers' attention focussed on the third quarter.

For that period, offers of customarily popular descriptions are reported to be less frequently in evidence. Some observers anticipate that an increased interest might develop, in consequence, for U.S. styles.
Slightly further ahead, some additional price testing has recently developed for European 1997/98 crop for early shipment.
